definitions.full: H5832. Azarel עֲזַרְאֵל proper name, masculine (El hath helped ); — Οζρειηλ , Εζριηλ , etc.; 1 warrior of David 1Chr 12:7 (van d. H. v. 12:6 ). 2 Levite musician 1Chr 25:18 (= עֻזִּיאֵל 25:4 ), B Αζαρια , A Εζριηλ . 3 a Danite 1Chr 27:22 , Αζαραηλ , Εζριηλ . 4 one with foreign wife Ezra 10:41 . 5 priestly name: a. Neh 11:13 . b. Neh 12:36 .
